message: 転ばなかった
The same morning commute as always. After treating myself to some soba for breakfast, I walk toward Ryuusei Academy with Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew, phew... You've been walking way too fast lately, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't been trying to, though?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ever since you became Student Council President, you've been having so much fun at school that you're speeding up without realizing it, aren't you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Neither of you noticed? Master Synn's hit a growth spurt, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really?! My legs actually got longer!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? You look totally the same to me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I get it! Your torso grew at the exact same ratio!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's just cruel!」

name: Misa
message: 「Good morning, Sakura-kun, Nanaka-san.」
Partway along the route to school, Misa joins up with us.
Ever since around the end of KiraFes, Misa started walking to school with us.

name: Misa
message: 「Now then.」
Misa gives a little hop and flexes her ankles, doing some light warm-up stretches.

name: Synn
message: 「Are we doing this again?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun! Let's see who can make it to school first--it's a match!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Playing speed-walking again this morning?」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude. I would never engage in anything so unseemly.」

name: Misa
message: 「As Student Council officers, we must set an example for the general student body by obeying all traffic rules and walking slowly and safely--to see who arrives at school first?!」

name: Misa
message: 「In other words, I am testing your qualifications as President, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It was something that grand?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I said, what you're doing is literally the same as speed-walking, isn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Go easy on her with those longer legs of yours. Can't let Hisa lose face, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「I will accept no charity from my rival!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Man, Misa really gets hung up on winning and losing.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why's that?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, Nanaka-san, what do you think is the opposite of 'win'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Obviously, the opposite of 'katsu' is 'croquette'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, beating Synn is pretty tough, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Over there, isn't that--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's Roro-chan and Emi-chan」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Near dawn, the sky flashed brightly and water fell down. It was a mysterious phenomenon I never saw in Heaven」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well you see, Amyrina, that is God taking pictures of the Human World」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And moved by the Student Council's endeavors, He shed tears」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's totally wrong」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Panda?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, President, Vice President, Treasurer, good morning」

name: Amyrina
message: 「H-Hello there」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A lot happened, but we managed to make up」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes, I'm sorry for making everyone worry about us」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't sweat it, don't sweat it. That's a relief」

name: Misa
message: 「If Sakura-kun is a little relieved, then I'm a hundred times relieved!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...You're too sweet, Synn! Female friendship doesn't go as smoothly as sweets, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Watch this?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「♪ Da~ru~ma~-san~ fell~...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「♪Oops, I tripped」
Nanaka tries to chop apart Lolotte and Amyrina's joined hands with a karate chop.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fugyah!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the assurance of Milady and Lady Amyrina's friendship to me, your humble butler, Riesling Tohyama」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I've been shot! I got shot!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, huh? I'm not hurt anywhere?」

name: Riesling
message: 「It was with the blunt edge」

name: Riesling
message: 「However, next time...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I won't do it, I won't do it, I won't ever do it again! The bond between those two is eternal!!」

name: Synn & Misa
message: 「S-Scary...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Old man? Did a pistol just go bang?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Rejoicing in Milady and Lady Amyrina's new beginning, I took the liberty of firing a celebratory salute」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, we're going to be late~」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, anyway... thank goodness!」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yeah」
